{{Quote|Hey&mdash;get Hayg on the commlink! If they don't evacuate those people in record time, we might as well start digging graves.|Lanius Carr|<ref name="Volatile Chemicals">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Volatile Chemicals|Corellia}}</ref>}}
'''Hayg''' was an individual who was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], [[Lanius Carr]] tried to reach Hayg to warn of the impending implosion of the [[Corellian Chemical Corporation]]'s [[Corellia Chemical Corporation factory|factory]] in the [[Labor Valley]].
